{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA will work for the release of all political prisoners incarcerated for their resistance to US imperialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work with colonized peoples for the forgiveness of all debts and the granting of reparations to the survivors of exploitation, as well as their descendants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA rejects the Monroe Doctrine and interference with Latin American states asserting their sovereignty against the US, including support for the use of law as a weapon of conflict (called lawfare).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports a united Ireland.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports full rights and equal protection for Native people, restoration of tribal sovereignty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA instructs the Bureau of Indian Affairs to work toward a program of repatriation of Native lands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA will stop seeking to dominate the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work toward a global just, green transition to achieve a sustainable economy and avert disastrous global climate change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"DSA will share technology based on global need not profit seeking, taking special account of the needs of Global South countries that are in the most danger.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"DSA will share the burden of preparing the world for inevitable climate change effects.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[9]},{"claim_text":"DSA will transform the rules and structures of the global economy—currently embodied in trade agreements and institutions like the World Bank and IMF—that establish and force upon the Global South a neoliberal world order, and replace them with a global economy that prioritizes the needs of the working class, equitable development, environmental protection, and sovereignty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[10]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
